name: inReality
source: A high school boy meets mysterious girl. The boy life changes slowly. His friend realizes there is something weird and trying to stop him. But nothing go as he hoped. This vn is originaly Indonesia subs and voice.
translation: 一名高中生遇到了神秘的女孩。男孩的生活慢慢发生了变化。他的朋友意识到有一些奇怪的事情并试图阻止他。但一切都没有如他​​所愿。这个vn最初是印度尼西亚的潜艇和声音。
